rationale: Fingerprints a model's weights, tokenizer, and architecture metadata and scores it against a reference database of known base models, giving an owner technical evidence a third-party model derives from theirs -- ownership verification via fingerprinting rather than a training transcript.

Memory-based, meta-learning, and locate-then-edit methods let an operator surgically overwrite a specific fact or behavior in an already-deployed model -- a concrete post-deployment correction option short of retraining or rollback.

Packages 12+ working unlearning algorithms that remove targeted knowledge/behavior from a deployed model, plus a TOFU/MUSE/WMDP harness to check the removal held -- a direct post-deployment correction intervention.

Ships 13+ pre-built machine-unlearning algorithms an operator can run against a trained model -- a direct source of post-deployment remediation techniques for a model found to have absorbed harmful content.

Comparative visual analytics across unlearning methods lets an operator judge which correction technique best trades off forgetting against retained utility before applying one -- supplies no unlearning algorithm itself, so eval not implement.

Runs model-serving containers inside TDX/SEV-SNP confidential VMs with NVIDIA H100 confidential computing so weights stay encrypted in memory and unreadable even to a compromised host or cloud operator -- an infrastructure-level control directly against weight exfiltration, with remote attestation so the deployment can be verified.

Code-ready reference deployments applying Intel SGX/TDX, LibOS, and remote attestation to cloud AI inference on major public clouds, giving an operator concrete recipes for keeping model weights encrypted and attested in an untrusted cloud environment.

Red-teams open-weight models with fine-tuning/jailbreak-tuning/embedding attacks under worst-case hyperparameter sweeps while tracking StrongREJECT safety and MMLU-Pro utility -- exactly the measurement needed to tell whether a tamper-resistance method survives malicious fine-tuning without destroying benign capability.
